name: Thick Hair
description: Thick hair is typically characterized by its robust texture and diameter, often requiring more product to achieve the desired style due to higher volume and density.
characteristics: May require more styling products for control
common_problems: Difficulties in achieving a smooth finish
Increased tendency towards frizz, especially with humidity
Dandruff or oiliness due to larger hair surface area
recommended_ingredients: Hydrating agents like glycerin and hyaluronic acid
Oil-based conditioners to moisturize without weighing down the hair
ingredients_to_avoid: Heavy silicones that can weigh thick hair down and make it look greasy
Alcohol-based products which may cause dryness
washing_frequency: Every other day or as needed, depending on oil production
oil_recommendation: Use a light to medium hold product suitable for thick hair

morning_routine.action: Apply a lightweight conditioner focusing on the mid-lengths and ends of the hair.
morning_routine.purpose: Moisturize without weighing down the hair.

night_routine.action: Style as usual, using a heat protectant before any heat styling if necessary.
night_routine.purpose: Prevent damage from heat styling tools.

weekly_care: Deep conditioning treatments once a week to maintain moisture and prevent breakage
heat_styling_recommendation: Use heat protectant and limit the use of high-temperature styling tools.
foods_for_healthy_hair: Protein-rich foods like eggs, fish, and legumes for strength
Omega-3 rich foods such as flaxseeds and walnuts for moisture
common_mistakes: Over-styling with heat tools leading to damage
Using heavy products that can weigh down the hair and cause oiliness
dont: Avoid brushing wet thick hair as it is more prone to breakage.
Do not use too much product, as this may make the hair look greasy.

seasonal_care.summer: Use lightweight products and avoid harsh sun exposure that can cause dryness.
seasonal_care.winter: Focus on deep conditioning and using heavier oils or butters for added moisture.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Maintain regular washing to prevent oil buildup and use hydrating shampoos.

expert_tips: Regular trims can help maintain thickness and prevent split ends.
Experiment with different styles and techniques to find what works best for your specific type of thick hair.
